value_updates.eligible_population: Holders of Small Block Tickets issued by the new active contract since the previous Small Block draw; old-contract NFTs and tickets are excluded.

decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that ticket and draw state starts with the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFTs; no additional change is required.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits random no-code recipients to holders in the new active contract and excludes old-contract-only holders.

The operational exclusion of old-contract NFTs may warrant qualifying broad FAQ claims about every NFT mint number and prize ticket, but the client did not explicitly request messaging revisions and the existing wording may refer implicitly to the active system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already makes only new-active-contract NFT mint numbers valid and excludes old-contract mint numbers.
The existing message-539 MODIFY fully captures restarted new-contract numbering and exclusion of old-contract mint numbers from referral use.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes dashboard reward and ticket accounting to the new active contract and excludes old-contract data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts project-system NFT visibility to the new active contract and excludes old-contract copies.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes public referral aggregates to new-active-contract activity and excludes old-contract referral data.
The source decision resets NFT, draw, and ticket participation but does not change the per-sale funding allocation, eligible funding sale types, or active prize-pool mechanism.
Restarting draws under a new contract does not change automatic prize transfer, winner announcements, or notification channels.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires mint and supply statistics to restart from NFT #1 under the new active contract and exclude old-contract copies.
